messages:
Ava: Starting a coordinated rollout tonight for header-based routing. Services involved: runtime v5.1.2 (kernel tweaks), router v3.9 (header-split), api v2.5 (compat layer), console schema change. Need explicit drain + pin plan for dedicated pools and quick rollback path.
Ravi: I'm runtime oncall. Suggest we do a tenant-isolated canary first on dedicated pools with quant-profile locked. If dedicated behaves, we mirror on hosted.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled: 1777660800 - staged rollout. Ticket INF-2021. Waves: canary-dedicated(2 hosts) -> canary-hosted 5% -> 25% -> full.
Kai: Router note: header-split requires runtime to advertise new header token. If runtime advert fails, router falls back but logs will blow up. Need a fast detection rule.
Nora: Console: schema change adds route.metadata.trace_id. It's backward compatible but UI will render new column. We should deploy console after api is at 25% to avoid UI errors for some enterprise dashboards.
Ava: Proposed sequence: 1) lock dedicated quant profile & drain to 0 new allocations 2) deploy runtime to two dedicated canary hosts 3) run smoke traffic with header=X-Exp=canary 4) if pass -> expand runtime on dedicated to 25% 5) router small canary using same header token 6) api thin rollout 7) merge & deploy console 8) unpin. Thoughts?
Ravi: Add step: after runtime canary, run a KV warmup for 10m to rehydrate caches. We had cold-start evictions last run.
Kai: Agree. Detection rules to enable before waves: infra.kv_eviction_rate, router.header_fallback_count, api.5xx.rate. Set pager to oncall if any > threshold.
Ezra: Rollback rules: any of -> sustained 3m increase in api.5xx by +1.8% absolute OR p95 api latency +150ms OR dedicated pool OOM events >1. If triggered, immediate stop of router expansion and rollback runtime on dedicated.
Nora: If console deploy fails due to schema mismatch, we keep api pinned and rollback console commit. Console rollback is manual.
Ava: Smoke test snippet (run from staging agent):
```
# header-split smoke
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "X-Route-Variant: canary" https://api.staging.redwood.ai/v1/health
```
Look for 200 and time_total < 0.25s median.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] running prechecks: quant-profile locked? yes; canary hosts healthy? yes. Initiating dedicated canary in 60s.
Ravi: I'll watch runtime.evictions and runtime.memory. If we see >5 evictions/min, abort.
Kai: I'll add a quick log filter to surface header fallback traces: `router.log filter "header_fallback" --since 10m` and post alerts.
Ezra: Also add a synthetic that hits a model-serving path since token errors spiked last time. Detect model.token_errors > 0.2% over baseline.
Ava: Ops comms: I'll post at 1777662000 to #ops and #enterprise-notify at 25% if steady. Release notes draft: https://git/repo/releases/inf-2021-notes.
Nora: Console PR ready to merge but will hold until API steady at 25%.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] dedicated canary started. Wave metadata: {"ticket":"INF-2021","wave":"dedicated-canary","hosts":2}. Status updates pinned to ticket.
Kai: Running warmup traffic now. KV miss dropped ~8% after 6m, good sign.
Ravi: Can confirm canary hosts memory stable. No evictions in last 5m. Proceed to expand dedicated runtime to 25% per plan.
Ava: Proceeding with router canary after runtime at 25% for 10m stable window. Keep monitoring header_fallback and api.5xx.
Ezra: If we need to abort, command is: `/release abort INF-2021` — will revert runtime & router to pinned images.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] temp hold between waves for manual validation. Next auto-step in 10m unless abort.
Nora: Merging console schema now to reduce drift; will queue deploy after API reaches 25%.
Ava: Final checks: support and security notified?
Nora: Security acked. Support posted a short FAQ for enterprise customers about header-split.
Kai: Alert thresholds set. Dashboards pinned.
Ravi: Standby to roll back runtime if OOM/evictions.
Ava: Thanks all — will post final go/no-go before router canary. :thumbsup:
